text.content: Old Desktop Navigation
Product assortment growth:

rich_text.plain_text: Product assortment growth:

text.content: Primary’s navigation had been the same since they launched in 2015 with just a few dozen products. By early 2019, the product assortment had grown to 300+, and it had become more and more challenging to communicate the the assortment within the existing navigation without breaking it.

rich_text.plain_text: Primary’s navigation had been the same since they launched in 2015 with just a few dozen products. By early 2019, the product assortment had grown to 300+, and it had become more and more challenging to communicate the the assortment within the existing navigation without breaking it.

text.content: Desire for more product storytelling:

rich_text.plain_text: Desire for more product storytelling:

text.content: The creative and merchandising teams wanted to do more editorial storytelling and to communicate seasonality. Editorial emails had historically been high performers, but there was no way to leverage that content in the site experience, which seemed like a significant missed opportunity.

Editorial emails had historically been high performers, but there was no way to leverage that content in the site experience, which seemed like a significant missed opportunity.

text.content: Quantitative & qualitative data:

rich_text.plain_text: Quantitative & qualitative data:

text.content: Analytics data and usability testing observations showed significant UX issues, especially in the desktop experience:

rich_text.plain_text: Analytics data and usability testing observations showed significant UX issues, especially in the desktop experience:

text.content: In testing, desktop users (who make up ~70% of purchases) struggled with flyouts because small hover areas required precise mouse movements.

rich_text.plain_text: In testing, desktop users (who make up ~70% of purchases) struggled with flyouts because small hover areas required precise mouse movements.

text.content: Within the desktop flyouts, products were shown as small thumbnails that were difficult for users to see. This wasn’t a good way to showcase our products.

rich_text.plain_text: Within the desktop flyouts, products were shown as small thumbnails that were difficult for users to see. This wasn’t a good way to showcase our products.

text.content: Analytics showed that most desktop users wouldn’t reach a product landing page (PLP) and would instead go directly to product detail pages (PDPs). Once there, it was difficult for users to view more products because they would need to go through the navigation again, amplifying the usability issues.

rich_text.plain_text: Analytics showed that most desktop users wouldn’t reach a product landing page (PLP) and would instead go directly to product detail pages (PDPs). Once there, it was difficult for users to view more products because they would need to go through the navigation again, amplifying the usability issues.

text.content: Analytics also showed that the default “top 10” category flyout was by far the most interacted-with, which suggests that users might have missed the ability to view other categories for products more specific to their interests.

rich_text.plain_text: Analytics also showed that the default “top 10” category flyout was by far the most interacted-with, which suggests that users might have missed the ability to view other categories for products more specific to their interests.

text.content: Results:

rich_text.plain_text: Results:

text.content: Most users talked about how they would organize their children’s closets by seasonality. Instead of arranging things by cut or fabric as merchandising had originally planned, they tended to arrange things by category, and then by seasonal attributes like sleeve length.

rich_text.plain_text: Most users talked about how they would organize their children’s closets by seasonality. Instead of arranging things by cut or fabric as merchandising had originally planned, they tended to arrange things by category, and then by seasonal attributes like sleeve length.

text.content: This is important, because most other retailers’ product assortments would naturally reflect seasonality as they phase products in and out of stock, but Primary’s assortment had always been intended to be evergreen, so this was a critical piece of insight for the business.
